name: البروفيسور يشرح
audience: Arabic-speaking adults seeking accessible explanations of psychology, attention, mental health, and human behavior
dialect: Clear conversational Arabic; preserve the source narrator's dialect and use precise Arabic for scientific terms
tone: Curious, humane, clear, and evidence-conscious; never diagnose viewers or promise a clinical outcome
style: Premium editorial illustration with tactile paper, confident ink shapes, restrained cobalt and warm amber accents, expressive but anatomically credible people, and strong foreground-background depth. Build episode-specific visual metaphors and clean mechanisms as separate still compositions; render all words, numerals, arrows, and highlights locally. No default talking mascot, generic floating brain, fake scientific chart, or repeated zoom cycle.
visual_directives: Ground human scenes in specific real-world behaviors, environmental observations, or recognizable daily attention lapses (such as searching past a visible object, forgetting an intention at a threshold, or attention captured by a competing cue) rather than a person presenting to camera or staged generic task performance
Vary narrative function across environmental wides, human-context scenes, observational details, mechanisms, and clean local diagrams
Use full-frame high-contrast local graphics for interactive exercises so viewers can actually perform the task
Treat psychology claims with visual restraint and show uncertainty when the narration does not establish causation or clinical efficacy

Never turn a promotional cognition claim into a successful before-and-after transformation; treat cognitive ability with restraint and show grounded human context or realistic uncertainty rather than visual proof of improvement or staged productivity
Introduce a playable full-frame local exercise graphic as soon as its rules begin, then keep people, hands, desks, props, and generated text off the exercise canvas
Reuse an identifiable participant only when continuity advances the story; repeated generic desk portraits, intense staring close-ups, and cosmetic reframes do not count as visual progression

Do not stage artificial 'performing focus' scenes such as purposeless drafting, arbitrary pen paths, drawing lines connecting dots, sorting cards, compass manipulation, or detective walls of notes; ground early beats in genuine, relatable daily situations
Never extend a non-diagram still by splitting it into adjacent shots with the same asset, framing, and motion; cut to a new narrative beat or use a purposeful referenced edit
Treat entity IDs as episode-global identities: details of an established environment remain in the same scene and use a reference operation rather than an unrelated regeneration
Generated scenes never request printed or legible words; books, screens, signs, and paper remain text-free or illegible unless deterministic local typography supplies the content

Animate interactive exercise instructions locally at the narration beat: show center fixation with a local highlight and carry each spoken ready or countdown cue with a local label while preserving the grid
forbidden_motifs: person staring forward at a clean desk
